17600.meaning1: (of a stream-enterer) who has one remaining human life
17600.commentary: (SNa) yo sot'āpanno hutvā ekam'eva attabhāvaṃ janetvā arahattaṃ pāpuṇāti, ayaṃ ekabījī nāma.

examples.text: taṃ vā pana anabhisambhavaṃ appaṭivijjhaṃ tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā ekabījī hoti, ekaṃ'y'eva mānusakaṃ bhavaṃ nibbattetvā dukkhass'antaṃ karoti.
kiṃ pana, bhāradvāja, atthi koci brāhmaṇānaṃ ekabrāhmaṇo'pi yo evam'āha, aham'etaṃ jānāmi, aham'etaṃ passāmi. idam'eva saccaṃ, mogham'aññan'ti?
araññe viharantānaṃ, santānaṃ brahmacārinaṃ, ekabhattaṃ bhuñjamānānaṃ, kena vaṇṇo pasīdatī'ti.

17605.meaning1: eating one meal a day; (comm) eating in one part of the day, even up to ten times
17605.commentary: (MNa) ekabhattiko'ti pātarāsabhattaṃ sāyamāsabhattan'ti dve bhattāni. tesu pātarāsabhattaṃ antomajjh'anhikena paricchinnaṃ, itaraṃ majjh'anhikato uddhaṃ anto-aruṇena. tasmā antomajjh'anhike dasakkhattuṃ bhuñjamāno'pi ekabhattiko'va hoti, taṃ sandhāya vuttaṃ ekabhattiko'ti.

examples.text: ekabhattiko hoti ratt'ūparato virato vikālabhojanā

sace pana tvaṃ, mahārāja, aṅgulimālaṃ passeyyāsi kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitaṃ, virataṃ pāṇ'ātipātā, virataṃ adinn'ādānā, virataṃ musāvādā, ekabhattikaṃ, brahmacāriṃ, sīlavantaṃ, kalyāṇadhammaṃ, kin'ti naṃ kareyyāsī'ti?

17606.commentary: (VINa) ekabhājane'ti ettha sace eko bhikkhu bhājanato phalaṃ vā pūvaṃ vā gahetvā gacchati, tasmiṃ apagate itarassa sesakaṃ bhuñjituṃ vaṭṭati. itarassā'pi tasmiṃ khīṇe puna gahetuṃ vaṭṭati.

examples.text: te kul'itthīhi kuladhītāhi kulakumārīhi kulasuṇhāhi kuladāsīhi saddhiṃ ekabhājane'pi bhuñjanti, ekathālake'pi pivanti, ek'āsane'pi nisīdanti, ekamañce'pi tuvaṭṭenti, ek'attharaṇā'pi tuvaṭṭenti, ekapāvuraṇā'pi tuvaṭṭenti, ek'attharaṇapāvuraṇā'pi tuvaṭṭenti
tiṭṭhatu bhavaṃ gotamo. atthi pana te bhoto gotamassa ekabhikkhu'pi sāvako yo āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭh'eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatī'ti?

17610.commentary: (VIN) dve ekamañce tuvaṭṭeyyun'ti ekāya nipannāya aparā nipajjati, āpatti pācittiyassa. ubho vā nipajjanti, āpatti pācittiyassa.

examples.text: te kul'itthīhi kuladhītāhi kulakumārīhi kulasuṇhāhi kuladāsīhi saddhiṃ ekabhājane'pi bhuñjanti, ekathālake'pi pivanti, ek'āsane'pi nisīdanti, ekamañce'pi tuvaṭṭenti, ek'attharaṇā'pi tuvaṭṭenti, ekapāvuraṇā'pi tuvaṭṭenti, ek'attharaṇapāvuraṇā'pi tuvaṭṭenti

17611.meaning1: rule about lying on the same bed

17612.meaning1: unanimous; with the same intention; in agreement

examples.text: tato jānapadā sabbe, senāpatipurohitā, sabbe ekamanā hutvā, chaḍḍanaṃ anumodisuṃ.

17613.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of ekamanta

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā kumbhakār'āvesanaṃ pavisitvā ekam'antaṃ tiṇasanthārakaṃ paññāpetvā nisīdi pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.
tena kho pana samayena kasibhāradvājassa brāhmaṇassa parivesanā vattati. atha kho bhagavā yena parivesanā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā ekam'antaṃ aṭṭhāsi.

17614.grammar: ind, adv, comp, loc sg of ekamantaṃ
17614.meaning1: to one side; apart; in a secluded place; in solitude
17614.meaning2: apart, at a distance; in private, on one's own; in a solitary place
17614.commentary: (THIa) khippaṃ pādāni dhovitvā, ekam'ante nisīdathā'ti idaṃ yasmā sayaṃ pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantā ācariy'upajjhāyānaṃ vattaṃ dassetvā attano divāṭṭhāne pāde dhovitvā raho nisinnā sadatthaṃ matthakaṃ pāpesi, tasmā tattha aññe'pi niyojentī avoca. (THIa) ekam'ante vivitte okāse

examples.text: karotha buddhasāsanaṃ, yaṃ katvā n'ānutappati, khippaṃ pādāni dhovitvā, ekam'ante nisīdathā'ti.
tassā dhammaṃ suṇitvāna, ekam'ante upāvisiṃ, pubbenivāsaṃ jānāmi, dibbacakkhu visodhitaṃ.

17615.meaning1: single mound of flesh; one heap of meat
17615.meaning2: single mash or mass of flesh

examples.text: khurapariyantena ce'pi cakkena yo imissā pathaviyā pāṇe ekamaṃsakhalaṃ ekamaṃsapuñjaṃ kareyya, n'atthi tatonidānaṃ pāpaṃ, n'atthi pāpassa āgamo.

17616.meaning1: one pile of flesh; single heap of meat

examples.text: khurapariyantena ce'pi cakkena yo imissā pathaviyā pāṇe ekamaṃsakhalaṃ ekamaṃsapuñjaṃ kareyya, n'atthi tatonidānaṃ pāpaṃ, n'atthi pāpassa āgamo.
kiṃ nu tvaṃ mataputtā'va, ekam'āsi rudammukhī, vanamajjhagatā ekā, purisaṃ nu gavesasī'ti.
kacci tvaṃ anagho bhikkhu, kacci nandī na vijjati, kacci taṃ ekam'āsīnaṃ, aratī n'ābhikīratī'ti.
anagho ve ahaṃ yakkha, atho nandī na vijjati, atho maṃ ekam'āsīnaṃ, aratī n'ābhikīratī'ti.

17619.commentary: (MNa) ekam'id'āhan'ti ettha idā'ti nipātamattaṃ, ekasmiṃ samaye ahan'ti vuttaṃ hoti, bhumm'atthe upayogavacanaṃ.

examples.text: ekam'id'āhaṃ, āvuso ānanda, samayaṃ idh'eva sāvatthiyaṃ viharāmi andhavanasmiṃ. tatth'āhaṃ tathārūpaṃ samādhiṃ samāpajjiṃ yathā n'eva pathaviyaṃ pathavisaññī ahosiṃ
ekam'id'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, samayaṃ ukkaṭṭhāyaṃ viharāmi subhagavane sālarājamūle.

17620.meaning1: with one root; with a single source; (comm) craving
17620.commentary: (SNa) ekamūlan'ti avijjā taṇhāya mūlaṃ, taṇhā avijjāya. idha pana taṇhā adhippetā.
17620.notes: (LDA) Now, what is this 'one root'? That too, we can understand in the light of the Phassamūlaka Sutta (SN36.10)… All feelings have contact as their only root (ekamūlaṃ).

examples.text: ekamūlaṃ dvi'r'āvaṭṭaṃ, timalaṃ pañcapattharaṃ, samuddaṃ dvādas'āvaṭṭaṃ, pātālaṃ atarī isī'ti.

17621.meaning1: based on one item; rooted in one thing
17621.meaning2: (what is) based on one item; (a statement or exposition) concerned with one item

17623.meaning2: (what is) based on one item; (a statement or exposition) concerned with one item

examples.text: ekam'ekañ'ca bhikkhuṃ paccekaṃ dussayugena acchādesi, āyasmantañ'ca ānandaṃ ticīvarena acchādesi, āyasmato ca ānandassa pañcasatavihāraṃ kārāpesī'ti.

vejayantassa kho, mārisa moggallāna, pāsādassa ekasataṃ niyyūhaṃ. ek'ekasmiṃ niyyūhe satta satta kūṭ'āgārasatāni. ekam'ekasmiṃ kūṭ'āgāre satta satta accharāyo. ekam'ekissā accharāya satta satta paricārikāyo.

17625.meaning1: each and every person; every individual

examples.text: atha kho āyasmā mahako āyasmantaṃ theraṃ etadavoca, sādhu khv'assa, bhante thera, sītako ca vāto vāyeyya, abbhasampilāpo ca assa, devo ca ekam'ekaṃ phusāyeyyā'ti.
abhijānāmi kho pan'āhaṃ, aggivessana, anekasatāya parisāya dhammaṃ desetā. apissu maṃ ekam'eko evaṃ maññati, mam'ev'ārabbha samaṇo gotamo dhammaṃ desetī'ti.

17626.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of ekameka

examples.text: atha kho āyasmato ānandassa etadahosi, sace kho ahaṃ kosinārake malle ekam'ekaṃ bhagavantaṃ vandāpessāmi, avandito bhagavā kosinārakehi mallehi bhavissati, ath'āyaṃ ratti vibhāyissati.

17627.grammar: ind, adv, comp, instr sg of ekameka
17627.meaning1: by each and every; through every individual

examples.text: ekam'ekena'pi, bhante, ratanena samannāgato rājā cakkavattī tatonidānaṃ sukhaṃ somanassaṃ paṭisaṃvediyetha, ko pana vādo sattahi ratanehi catūhi ca iddhīhī'ti?

17628.meaning1: only one; just one; merely a single

examples.text: ekam'pi ce pāṇam'aduṭṭhacitto, mettāyati kusalī tena hoti, sabbe ca pāṇe manas'ānukampī, pahūtamariyo pakaroti puññaṃ.
so anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarāmi, seyyath'idaṃ, ekam'pi jātiṃ dve'pi jātiyo tisso'pi jātiyo catasso'pi jātiyo pañca'pi jātiyo dasa'pi jātiyo vīsam'pi jātiyo tiṃsam'pi jātiyo

17629.meaning1: sole rulership; sole dominion; sovereign power

examples.text: pathabyā ekarajjena, saggassa gamanena vā, sabbalok'ādhipaccena, sot'āpattiphalaṃ varaṃ.

17630.meaning1: one night; single night; one night alone

examples.text: ekarattena ubhayo, tvañ'c'eva dhanusekha ca, ubho jātettha pañcālā, sahāyā susamāvayā.

17631.meaning1: for even one night; for one night only

examples.text: niṭṭhitacīvarasmiṃ bhikkhunā ubbhatasmiṃ kathine ekarattam'pi ce bhikkhu ticīvarena vippavaseyya, aññatra bhikkhusammutiyā nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
bhikkhunupassayo nāma yattha bhikkhuniyo ekarattam'pi vasanti.

17632.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of akeratta

examples.text: niṭṭhitacīvarasmiṃ bhikkhunā ubbhatasmiṃ kathine ekarattam'pi ce bhikkhu ticīvarena vippavaseyya, aññatra bhikkhusammutiyā nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
sace te, bhaggava, agaru viharemu āvesane ekarattan'ti. na kho me, bhante, garu. atthi c'ettha pabbajito paṭhamaṃ vās'ūpagato. sace so anujānāti, viharatha, bhante, yathāsukhan'ti.
atha kho, rājañña, aññataro janapade sattho vuṭṭhāsi. atha kho so sattho tassa aggikassa jaṭilassa assamassa sāmantā ekarattiṃ vasitvā pakkāmi.

17634.meaning1: (of a journey) staying for one night; (comm) completing in one night
17634.commentary: (UDa) ekarattiparivāsenā'ti sabbasmiṃ magge ekarattivāsen'eva agamāsi. suppārakapaṭṭanato hi sāvatthi vīsayojanasate hoti, tañ'c'āyaṃ ettakaṃ addhānaṃ ekarattivāsena agamāsi. yadā suppārakato nikkhanto, tadah'eva sāvatthiṃ sampatto'ti.

examples.text: atha kho bāhiyo dārucīriyo tāya devatāya saṃvejito tāva'd'eva suppārakamhā pakkāmi. sabbattha ekarattiparivāsena yena sāvatthi jetavanaṃ anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāmo ten'upasaṅkami.

17635.meaning1: interval of one night; duration of one day

examples.text: akkodhano vigatakhilo'ham'asmi, anutīre mahiy'ekarattivāso, vivaṭā kuṭi nibbuto gini, atha ce patthayasī pavassa deva.
so taṃ ādāya sabbattha ekarattivāsena gacchanto ekaṃ phāsukaṭṭhānaṃ patvā nivāsaṃ gaṇhi

17638.meaning1: having one taste; with a single flavour

examples.text: seyyathā'pi mahāsamuddo ekaraso loṇaraso, evam'eva kho ayaṃ dhammavinayo ekaraso vimuttiraso.
seyyathā'pi nāma mahatī ekarukkhikā nāvā, evam'assa kāyo hoti. seyyathā'pi nāma mahantaṃ soṇḍikākiḷañjaṃ, evam'assa phaṇo hoti.

17641.meaning1: single form; single material thing; single sight

examples.text: n'āhaṃ, ānanda, ekarūpam'pi samanupassāmi yattha rattassa yath'ābhiratassa rūpassa vipariṇām'aññathābhāvā na uppajjeyyuṃ soka-parideva-dukkha-domanass'ūpāyāsā.

17644.meaning1: one measure; one definition; one classification

examples.text: kataman'ti chabbidhā vuttaṃ, katamāni catubbidhāni, katamo pañcavidho vutto, sabbesaṃ ekasaṅkhānaṃ pañcanayapadāni cā'ti.

vejayantassa kho, mārisa moggallāna, pāsādassa ekasataṃ niyyūhaṃ. ek'ekasmiṃ niyyūhe satta satta kūṭ'āgārasatāni. ekam'ekasmiṃ kūṭ'āgāre satta satta accharāyo. ekam'ekissā accharāya satta satta paricārikāyo.
so ekasatarājaparivuto sakalajambudīparajjaṃ anusāsanto cintesi, ahaṃ pubbe khuddako ahosiṃ, so'mhi idāni attano ñāṇasampattiyā sakalajambudīpamaṇḍalassa issaro rājā jāto.
yāvatā kho, cunda, eta'r'ahi satthāro loke uppannā, n'āhaṃ, cunda, aññaṃ ekasatthāram'pi samanupassāmi evaṃlābh'agga-yas'aggappattaṃ yathar'iv'āhaṃ.

17651.meaning1: sameness; uniformity; fact of being one and the same
17651.meaning2: fact of being the same; suchness

examples.text: iti kho, bhikkhave'ti evaṃ kho, bhikkhave. tādī'y'eva tādī'ti tāditā nāma ekasadisatā. tathāgato ca yādiso lābh'ādīsu, tādiso'va alābh'ādīsu.
n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, aññaṃ ekasaddam'pi samanupassāmi yaṃ evaṃ purisassa cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati yatha'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, itthisaddo. itthisaddo, bhikkhave, purisassa cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatī'ti.

17653.meaning1: having one origin; with a single source

17654.commentary: (DNt) dvīhi avayavehi samosaranti nibbattanavasena samaṃ vattanti ito'ti samosaraṇaṃ, paccayo, ekaṃ samosaraṇaṃ etāsan'ti ekasamosaraṇā. kena pana ekasamosaraṇā'ti āha vedanāyā'ti.

examples.text: tasmā't'ih'ānanda, es'eva hetu etaṃ nidānaṃ esa samudayo esa paccayo pariyesanāya, yadidaṃ taṇhā. iti kho, ānanda, ime dve dhammā dvayena vedanāya ekasamosaraṇā bhavanti.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, purisaṃ sallena vijjheyya. tam'enaṃ dutiyena sallena anuvedhaṃ na vijjheyya. evañ'hi so, bhikkhave, puriso ekasallena vedanaṃ vedayati.

17657.meaning1: ascetic wearing a loin-cloth; one robe ascetic

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena satta ca jaṭilā satta ca nigaṇṭhā satta ca acelakā satta ca ekasāṭakā satta ca paribbājakā parūḷhakacchanakhalomā khārivividham'ādāya bhagavato avidūre atikkamanti.
tatr'idaṃ, bhante, pūraṇena kassapena lohit'ābhijāti paññattā, nigaṇṭhā ekasāṭakā.

17659.meaning1: for (the benefit of) a single person; for (the good of) an individual
17659.meaning2: relating to one body; connected with one body

examples.text: yo pan'āyaṃ, bho gotama, yassa vā tassa vā kulā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito ekam'attānaṃ dameti, ekam'attānaṃ sameti, ekam'attānaṃ parinibbāpeti, evam'ass'āyaṃ ekasārīrikaṃ puññappaṭipadaṃ paṭipanno hoti, yadidaṃ pabbajj'ādhikaraṇan'ti.

17660.meaning1: with one hall; single-halled; (or) with a single sal tree
17660.commentary: (MNa) yasmā pan'ettha paṭhamaṃ ekā sālā ahosi, pacchā mahāpuññaṃ poṭṭhapādaparibbājakaṃ nissāya bahū sālā katā, tasmā tam'eva ekaṃ sālaṃ upādāya laddhanāmavasena ekasālako'ti vuccati.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena poṭṭhapādo paribbājako samayappavādake tinduk'ācīre ekasālake mallikāya ārāme paṭivasati mahatiyā paribbājakaparisāya saddhiṃ tiṃsamattehi paribbājakasatehi.

17661.meaning1: name of a village in Kosala

examples.text: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosalesu viharati ekasālāyaṃ brāhmaṇagāme. tena kho pana samayena bhagavā mahatiyā gihiparisāya parivuto dhammaṃ deseti.

17662.meaning1: same legal boundary; one legal territory

examples.text: te ca kho hatthapāsaṃ avijahitvā ekasīmāyaṃ ṭhitā.
ek'āsanaṃ ekaseyyaṃ, eko caram'atandito, eko damayam'attānaṃ, van'ante ramito siyā.

17666.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of eka

examples.text: 458, 461. kvac'ādivaṇṇānam'ekassarānaṃ dvebhāvo.

ādibhūtānaṃ vaṇṇānaṃ ekassarānaṃ kvaci dvebhāvo hoti. titikkhati, jigucchati, tikicchati, vīmaṃsati, bubhukkhati, pivāsati, daddallati, dadāti, jahāti, caṅkamati. kvacī'ti kim'atthaṃ? kampati, calati.
abhabbā [carati, abhabbo evam'upari'pi ekavacanen'eva dissati]

17670.meaning2: having the same basis or ground; relating to the same matter

17672.meaning2: of one year's standing; having been ordained for one year

17673.meaning2: for one year; in one year

examples.text: suṇantu bhonto mama ekavācaṃ, amhāka buddho ahu khantivādo, na hi sādhu yaṃ uttamapuggalassa, sarīrabhāge siyā sampahāro.

17676.commentary: (ANa) na ekavācikam'pi bhaṇitabbaṃ maññatī'ti mā, āvuso, saṅghena saddhiṃ evaṃ avacā'ti ekavacanam'pi vattabbaṃ na maññati.

examples.text: āyasmato, bhante, anuruddhassa bāhiyo nāma saddhivihāriko kevalakappaṃ saṅghabhedāya ṭhito. tatr'āyasmā anuruddho na ekavācikam'pi bhaṇitabbaṃ maññatī'ti.

17680.meaning1: (gram) having one conjugation; with the same declension; with the same inflection

examples.text: nāmānaṃ ekavibhattikānaṃ yo samuccayo, so dvandasañño hoti.
kathañ'ca, thera, ekavihāro vitthārena paripuṇṇo hoti. idha, thera, yaṃ atītaṃ taṃ pahīnaṃ, yaṃ anāgataṃ taṃ paṭinissaṭṭhaṃ, paccuppannesu ca attabhāvapaṭilābhesu chandarāgo suppaṭivinīto.
tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu theranāmako ekavihārī c'eva hoti ekavihārassa ca vaṇṇavādī.
sabb'ābhibhuṃ sabbaviduṃ sumedhaṃ, sabbesu dhammesu anūpalittaṃ, sabbañ'jahaṃ taṇhākkhaye vimuttaṃ, tam'ahaṃ naraṃ ekavihārī'ti brūmī'ti.
vajjanīyā ca puggalā tasmiṃ na honti kiṃ? gahaṭṭhapaṇḍak'ādayo ekavīsati vajjanīyā puggalā hatthapāsato bahikaraṇavasena vajjetabbā. te asmiṃ na honti.
examples.source: VIN PAT PK saṅghuposatha pubbakaraṇādi vidhi

examples.text: ekavīsatime bāvīsatime tevīsatime ca vagge sabbesaṃ therānaṃ sayaṃkatena puññena laddhanāmāni, katapuññānañ'ca nānattaṃ tesaṃ byākaraṇadāyakānaṃ buddhānaṃ nāmāni vasitanagarāni ca heṭṭhā vuttanayattā sabbāni'pi uttānāneva. apadānagāthānam'attho ca nay'ānuyogena suviññeyyo'y'evā'ti.

17689.meaning1: existence with one constituent; purely material being

17690.meaning1: at one time; on one occasion

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme
atha kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi, ārādhayiṃsu vata me, bhikkhave, bhikkhū ekaṃ samayaṃ cittaṃ. idh'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhū āmantesiṃ, ahaṃ kho, bhikkhave, ek'āsanabhojanaṃ bhuñjāmi.
hatthidamakena, bhikkhave, hatthidammo sārito ekaṃ'y'eva disaṃ dhāvati, puratthimaṃ vā pacchimaṃ vā uttaraṃ vā dakkhiṇaṃ vā.
taṃ vā pana anabhisambhavaṃ appaṭivijjhaṃ tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā ekabījī hoti, ekaṃ'y'eva mānusakaṃ bhavaṃ nibbattetvā dukkhass'antaṃ karoti.

17692.meaning1: definite; sure; straight; with absolute assurance

examples.text: atthi, bhikkhave, pañho ek'aṃsabyākaraṇīyo, atthi, bhikkhave, pañho vibhajjavyākaraṇīyo, atthi, bhikkhave, pañho paṭipucchāvyākaraṇīyo, atthi, bhikkhave, pañho ṭhapanīyo

17693.meaning1: one part; one side; single component

examples.text: evam'ass'āyaṃ apaṇṇako dhammo dussamatto samādinno, ek'aṃsaṃ pharitvā tiṭṭhati, riñcati kusalaṃ ṭhānaṃ.

17695.meaning1: which should be given a straight answer; which should be answered categorically

examples.text: sac'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, puggalo pañhaṃ puṭṭho samāno ek'aṃsabyākaraṇīyaṃ pañhaṃ na ek'aṃsena byākaroti, vibhajjabyākaraṇīyaṃ pañhaṃ na vibhajja byākaroti, paṭipucchābyākaraṇīyaṃ pañhaṃ na paṭipucchā byākaroti, ṭhapanīyaṃ pañhaṃ na ṭhapeti, evaṃ sant'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, puggalo akaccho hoti.
atthi bhikkhave pañho ek'aṃsabyākaraṇīyo, atthi pañho vibhajjabyākaraṇīyo, atthi pañho paṭipucchābyākaraṇīyo, atthi pañho ṭhapanīyo.

17696.meaning2: developed in one part; practised for one aspect

17697.commentary: (DNa) ek'aṃsabhāvito'ti ek'aṃsāya ekakoṭṭhāsāya bhāvito, dibbānaṃ vā rūpānaṃ dassan'atthāya dibbānaṃ vā saddānaṃ savan'atthāya bhāvito'ti attho.

examples.text: idha, mahāli, bhikkhuno puratthimāya disāya ek'aṃsabhāvito samādhi hoti dibbānaṃ rūpānaṃ dassanāya piyarūpānaṃ kām'ūpasaṃhitānaṃ rajanīyānaṃ, no ca kho dibbānaṃ saddānaṃ savanāya piyarūpānaṃ kām'ūpasaṃhitānaṃ rajanīyānaṃ.

17699.meaning1: straight answer; definite statement; categorical answer

examples.text: ek'aṃsavacanaṃ ekaṃ, vibhajjavacan'āparaṃ, tatiyaṃ paṭipuccheyya, catutthaṃ pana ṭhāpaye.
